security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Private messenger with no accounts or identifiers
bundle.longDescription: lethe is a prototype privacy-first messenger: no accounts, phone numbers or user IDs. Contacts connect with one-time invitations over anonymous relay queues, and messages are end-to-end encrypted with the Double Ratchet.
